subject: Evaluation roadmap, milestones, and commercial bundle offer
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@cloudstudio.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@cloudstudio.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Eval plan + timeline — looking to lock commits and tier pricing

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — our team was impressed with latency and the observability dashboard. We want to formalize a short evaluation roadmap (2–4 weeks of POC + 8–12 week pilot ramp) so we can show internal stakeholders a clear path to procurement.

Couple of asks up front:
- Can you share a mutual action plan (MAP) we can use for internal sign-off?
- What pricing/credits can you link to MAP milestones (e.g., evaluation credits, pilot discount after commit, premium support add-on)?
- We need observability log retention bumped for the pilot (90 days vs your default 30) — what does that cost as an add-on or bundle?

We’re targeting a decision by end of July — curious what commercial flexibility looks like if we commit to a 6‑month reserve after pilot.

Best,
Jordan
Director of ML Platforms
CloudStudio.ai

-----
Attachment: requirements-summary.pdf (stub)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@cloudstudio.ai>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval plan + timeline — looking to lock commits and tier pricing

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear asks. I’ve sketched a MAP and attached a template you can edit. High level proposal below; attached are a draft SOW and pricing tiers for visibility.

Proposed MAP (high level):
1) Week 0–2: POC — small integration, 100K tokens/day test, Redwood provides $10k in evaluation credits + onboarding sessions.
2) Week 3–10: Pilot — ramp to 500K tokens/day, 30% discount on hosted pricing during pilot subject to signal quality thresholds.
3) Week 11–24: Ramp/commit — if CloudStudio signs a 6‑month reserved commit (monthly baseline), we offer a 15% sustained discount and premium support bundle for first 3 months.

Observability retention: we can extend retention to 90 days as an add-on. Option A: standalone subscription ($4k/month). Option B: include in the premium support bundle (first 3 months included, then $2.5k/month).

Credits and milestones: evaluation credits applied during POC; pilot discount applied after successful pilot acceptance criteria; commit discount begins on signed effective date of reserve.

Next steps I recommend: Rafael will share a pricing addendum with tiered commit levels (3/6/12 months) and the SOW. If that looks good, we can produce a DocuSign with the MAP + SOW as attachments.

Attaching: Redwood_MAP_Template_v3.docx, SOW-Draft-CloudStudio.pdf, pricing-tiers-2026.xlsx

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30‑minute call tomorrow to walk through.

— Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@cloudstudio.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval plan + timeline — pricing tiers and commit examples

Jordan — quick pricing clarifications and three commit scenarios so you have concrete numbers to model: 

Commit scenarios (monthly baseline after pilot):
- 3 month reserve: 20M tokens/month baseline = 10% discount; includes 60 days observability retention add-on at $3k/mo.
- 6 month reserve: 20M tokens/month baseline = 15% discount; includes premium support (SLA + 24/7 escalation) for first 3 months and 90 day retention included.
- 12 month reserve: 20M tokens/month baseline = 22% discount; includes premium support for first 6 months, priority roadmap intake, and 180 day retention at discounted rate.

Pilot/POC credits: We’ll provide $10k evaluation credits. If you hit the pilot acceptance criteria (latency < 120ms p50 and qualitative evaluation by your ML team), pilot discount applies retroactively to pilot usage up to 500K tokens/day.

Regarding observability: if you include premium support bundle with the 6‑month commit we will waive the setup fee and cover first‑month overage credits (up to $2k). We can also add 10k tokens/month of free inference credits for the pilot to help with stress tests.

Let me know which commit level you want Rafael—sorry I mean Jordan—(ha) — pick one and we’ll produce an addendum. Happy to jump on a quick call to run through numbers.

— Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@cloudstudio.ai>

Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval plan + timeline — pricing tiers and commit examples

Thanks Rafael and Vanessa — this is super helpful. A few clarifying notes from our procurement and infra team: 
- We prefer the 6‑month reserve but need the 90‑day retention included in writing.
- Can you confirm the pilot acceptance criteria explicitly (we need it in the MAP so legal can reference).
- For the premium support bundle, can you detail what “24/7 escalation” means (SLA targets, response times)?

We can tentatively agree to 6‑month reserve at 15% discount pending the finalized MAP + addendum wording and a SOW that lists acceptance tests. If those are aligned, we’ll sign the DocuSign by next Wednesday and aim for a production ramp in September.

Best,
Priya Singh
VP Infrastructure | CloudStudio.ai
